note: KTD13's model-id pin ledger. Every op of every routing profile is either pinned by a committed eval receipt or carries a deferral naming what would close it and which unit owns closing it. An op in neither fails `bun test` (test/ai/model-id-pin.test.ts). Advancing a routed id in src/ai/routing.ts without re-scoring its op is the drift this file exists to make loud: the receipts that make R6's floors meaningful were scored against specific model ids, and 'a floor miss indicts the architecture, not the model tier' is only true while production runs those ids. Nothing is pinned yet, and that is the honest state of Phase 1 — see each deferral's note. One further honest statement as of 2026-08-16: three hosted rows now route to an id that CANNOT carry a dated pin, because the endpoint serving them publishes none. That is declared on the row rather than smuggled, and its cost to this file's guarantee is spelled out in the deferral that covers those ops.

deferrals.awaiting: the first green `bun run eval:live-parity` run against provider-sourced committed vectors
deferrals.note: The two R6a receipts record embedding_source.model = synthetic-lexical-v1. That is the fixture's deterministic lexical generator (evals/embeddings.ts), NOT a routed model id — no embedding provider is reachable from this environment, so no committed vector has ever been produced by the routed model. A reader counting receipts would otherwise read the calibration receipts as pinning this op. The pin lands with the first live-parity receipt, which is the first artifact that observes the routed model at all.

deferrals.note: The canary tier is the only thing that calls the judge op. It needs a live tenant on the real substrate and a produced output to grade; until U11 ships the consolidation ops there is nothing for a judge to score, so the harness reports `nothing_gradeable` rather than a receipt.

deferrals.awaiting: U11's exit gate — each op clears R6's canary floors with a receipt naming its model id
deferrals.note: U7 owns the harness; these ops do not exist in Phase 1, so a Phase-1 gate over them would be signed off empty. The plan splits the KTD13 gate for exactly this reason (Gap #19). SINCE 2026-08-16 there is a second thing to say about three of the five: extract, enrich and contradiction moved onto Cloudflare's Unified Billing passthrough, whose catalog publishes only the undated alias `google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite` — the dated snapshot this discipline is built on resolves nowhere on that endpoint. The row declares itself `unpinnable` in `src/ai/routing.ts` with that reason, and the validator refuses the declaration on any id that COULD have been pinned, so the hole is one row wide. What it costs is real and is written down here rather than discovered later: when these three are finally scored, the receipt will name a moving alias, so 'production runs the model the receipt was scored against' becomes an assumption instead of a fact, and a vendor advancing the alias will invalidate the receipt with no signal. The self-host profile keeps the dated id and can still be pinned properly, which is the comparison that would expose a drift.

deferrals.awaiting: U11's exit gate — transcription clears R6's canary floor with a receipt naming its model id
deferrals.note: U21 shipped the phase, so this op routes: `transcribe` is the first model phase of every paid cycle (src/worker/consolidate/phases.ts:PHASE_OP). What it does not have is a score. It joined EXIT_GATE_OPS with a workload row and a cost line, graded against the committed gold at evals/fixtures/transcription.ts, and it defers on the same authorised-spend condition as the other five. TWO CHANGES on 2026-08-16. The seat is now `@cf/moondream/moondream3.1-9B-A2B`, not the llama row: the llama seat requires accepting Meta's licence terms on the user's behalf, and moondream's price is now published, which was the only blocker `oos.moondream-screenshot-specialist` was declined on. And the seat returns an empty result for every documented input form on the live account — so this deferral is now blocked on something earlier than authorised spend, namely the seat producing any output at all. See `upstream/concepts.jsonl:imp.vision-seat-empty-result` for the recorded evidence and the control call that makes it a finding about the seat rather than about the request.

deferrals.awaiting: a self-host scoring run, which no unit currently owns
deferrals.note: The self-host profile remaps five Cloudflare-hosted rows to an operator's own endpoint serving the same weights (src/ai/routing.ts). Its ids drift independently of the hosted ones and its quality is unmeasured: no receipt in this repo was produced against it. Recorded here rather than omitted, because a profile absent from this ledger would be a profile whose ids nothing compares — which is the vacuous-guard failure this file is built against. The cost-down A/B in U13 is the first run that has a reason to score it.
